metadata.report_title: BusInsight Data, Source, and Artifact Reconciliation Audit
metadata.objective: Reconcile four evidence layers: Local Raw Data, Local Implementation Artifacts, Official Published Literature (Zenodo/MDPI), and External Reproducibility Repository.

official_source.paper_title: From Raw GPS to GTFS: A Real-World Open Dataset for Bus Travel Time Prediction
official_source.citation: Mansurova, A., Mussina, A., Aubakirov, S., Nugumanova, A., & Yedilkhan, D. (2025). Data, 10(8), 119
official_source.documented_collection_period: July 29, 2024 to September 21, 2024 (55 consecutive calendar days)
official_source.provenance: Astana, Kazakhstan (City Transportation Systems LLP / CTS). Derived from AVL GPS vehicle tracking logs.

paper_vs_local.notes: Exact match. Route 51 never existed in this dataset.
Exact match in stops.txt and segment_level_data.csv.
Exact match in trips.txt and segment_level_data.csv.
Exact row count and file size match.
stop_times.txt has 785,976 records, 1:1 mapped to segments.

paper_vs_local.local_measured: Permits derivative academic and research use
paper_vs_local.notes: Protected under read-only Original Data directory.

terminal_dispatch_flag.explanation: Exactly 19,062 trips start at segment 1. Exactly 707 trips began GPS logging mid-route at segment > 1 (segment 2: 453 trips, segment 3: 111 trips, etc.). Terminal dispatch was defined as segment == 1, yielding 19,062 rows.

route_segment_summary_rows.reconciliation: The true row count is 300 rows across 6 route-directions (Route 12: 109, Route 10: 96, Route 46: 95). The 202-row claim was an ungrounded hallucination in the previous audit.

journey_training_data_rows.reconciliation: The true row count is 15,339,161 data rows (2.69 GB), generated via upper-triangle stop-to-stop pairs (i <= j) across 19,769 trips on non-terminal segments. The ~7.16M claim was an ungrounded hallucination in the previous audit.

task_2b_reconciliation.terminal_segment_treatment: segment == 1 was excluded from non_term prior to journey pair iteration. As a result, min start_segment is 2, and initial route terminal stops (e.g. Airport on Route 10 Dir 2, Railway Station on Route 10 Dir 1) never appear as start_stop_name in journey_training_data.csv.

audit_reconciliation.origin_of_discrepancies: The previous audit file (Reports/full_project_audit.md) was synthesized in Turn 8 without reading or measuring local files. It hallucinated 2023 dates, Route 51, 202 segment groups, 7.16M journey rows, and non-existent quality flag counts.

debunked_claims.fact: All local files, raw files, and published paper confirm dates are July 29, 2024 through September 21, 2024.
All files confirm routes are 10, 12, and 46. Route 51 does not exist.

debunked_claims.claim: stop_times.txt has 805,745 rows and size 27.8 MB
debunked_claims.fact: stop_times.txt has 785,976 rows and size 49.8 MB.

validated_audit_findings.status: Confirmed True. Filtering terminal_dispatch_flag == 0 purged segment 1 from journey pairs, preventing initial terminal stops from acting as origins.
Confirmed True. stop_times.txt contains GPS-derived timestamps, not an ex-ante timetable schedule.
Confirmed True. shapes.txt does not exist in GTFS.
Confirmed True. 148 unique device IDs match 148 unique vehicles in trips.txt.

comparison_points.our_project_does: Uses identical Zenodo raw files, 785,976 records, identical dates, identical routes.

comparison_points.source_says: Physically removes September 3-4, 2024 (3,257 records deleted due to data collection failure; 782,719 remaining).
comparison_points.our_project_does: Preserves 100% of rows (785,976 retained; 0 deleted), keeps anomalous dates in dataset.
comparison_points.difference: External repo deletes 3,257 rows; BusInsight retains all rows.
comparison_points.possible_implication: BusInsight avoids data destruction. However, ML models in BusInsight might need to handle or flag Sep 3-4 data collection drops.

comparison_points.source_says: Physically removes outliers per segment/direction using IQR threshold [Q1 - 1.5*IQR, Q3 + 1.5*IQR].
comparison_points.our_project_does: Non-destructive flagging: zero_run_time_flag, extreme_travel_time_flag (> 30 min), segment_gap_after_flag.
comparison_points.difference: External repo deletes rows; BusInsight flags rows.
comparison_points.possible_implication: BusInsight preserves complete operational history for operator analytics while supporting filtering via standard_travel_time_eligible.

comparison_points.source_says: Models only single segments and whole trips aggregated to route level. Does NOT construct passenger OD journeys.
comparison_points.our_project_does: Constructs all stop-to-stop passenger journeys (i <= j pairs), generating 15,339,161 journey records.
comparison_points.difference: BusInsight provides full passenger-facing multi-segment travel intelligence.
comparison_points.possible_implication: BusInsight has significantly higher product utility and engineering complexity.

discrepancies.resolution: 2024 is verified ground truth across all raw files, data files, and external literature. 2023 was an ungrounded audit hallucination.

discrepancies.issue: Route Segment Summary Row Count (300 vs 202)
discrepancies.resolution: 300 rows is verified on disk in route_segment_summary.csv. 202 rows was an ungrounded audit hallucination.
15,339,161 rows is verified on disk in journey_training_data.csv. 7,164,188 rows was an ungrounded audit hallucination.
19,062 rows is verified on disk. 707 trips started at segment > 1 due to mid-route GPS startup. The 19,769 claim incorrectly assumed every trip had segment 1.

confirmed_facts: The raw dataset contains 785,976 segment records spanning 55 consecutive days from 2024-07-29 to 2024-09-21.
The dataset covers exactly 3 routes: Routes 10, 12, and 46 (CTS, Astana, Kazakhstan).
Exactly 19,769 trips and 201 stops are present with 100% referential integrity.
deviceid has 148 unique values and exactly matches vehicle_id in trips.txt.
Data cleaning in Task 2A preserved 100% of rows (785,976 rows, 0 deleted), marking 765,944 eligible and 20,032 ineligible.
In journey_training_data.csv, segment 1 was filtered out, omitting route departure terminals from ever acting as journey origins.
stop_times.txt contains GPS-observed timestamps, meaning no ex-ante scheduled timetable exists.
shapes.txt does not exist in GTFS, meaning route map polylines require external snapping or schematic representation.
unresolved_items: Whether the 707 trips starting at segment > 1 represent data collection truncation or operational mid-route insertions.
Whether the September 3-4, 2024 collection drop (3,257 rows) should be excluded from future ML training sets as done in the external thesis repo.

project_owner_decisions.title: Journey Dataset Origin Terminal Inclusion
project_owner_decisions.description: Whether to re-generate journey_training_data.csv to include segment 1 with zeroed initial dwell, enabling passenger journeys to originate at route terminals (e.g. Airport and Railway Station).
options: Option A: Include segment 1 run time while excluding initial dwell (restores terminal departures).
Option B: Keep current dataset (terminal departures remain omitted; documented as intermediate-only).

project_owner_decisions.title: Core Delay Value Proposition Framing
project_owner_decisions.description: Whether to frame BusInsight around Travel Time Reliability and Buffer Time Index vs attempting to synthesize an artificial scheduled timetable.
options: Option A: Travel Time Reliability, Buffer Time Index, and Free-Flow Excess Delay (Recommended).
Option B: Synthesize artificial scheduled timetable based on planned headways.

project_owner_decisions.title: Map Geometry & Routing Strategy
project_owner_decisions.description: How to visualize bus routes on web maps given the absence of shapes.txt.
options: Option A: Generate offline road-snapped GeoJSON polylines via OSRM for the 6 route-directions.
Option B: Display stop markers connected with dashed schematic vectors.

recommendations.recommendation: Correct journey generation logic in analytical_features.py to retain segment 1 transit run time while excluding origin layover dwell.
recommendations.reason: Allows passenger queries originating at terminal stations like Astana Airport.
recommendations.evidence: Global min start_segment in current journey dataset is 2.

recommendations.recommendation: Archive or annotate Reports/full_project_audit.md to prevent confusion caused by hallucinated 2023 metrics.
recommendations.reason: Full audit report contained ungrounded hallucinated metrics that contradict physical files.
recommendations.evidence: 2023 dates, Route 51, 202 summary rows, 7.16M journey rows found only in full_project_audit.md.

recommendations.recommendation: Evaluate excluding or flagging September 3-4, 2024 (3,257 rows) during ML training window selection.
recommendations.reason: Data collection outage on those dates produced abnormally low counts (111 and 3,146 records).
recommendations.evidence: Documented in external thesis and verified in local clean dataset.
